title: Notes played together
summary: Play three notes at the same moment and you have a new thing with its own name.

steps.title: Chord
steps.body:
So far you have played notes one after another. Press three or more notes at the same moment and you get a **chord**. Two notes together are just an interval; three or more make a chord.

**Why it matters:** Chords are what the band plays under the tune. When someone says "the chords for this song", they mean these groups of notes, one after another.

steps.title: One chord, three notes
steps.body: C, E and G pressed together make one chord. Hold all three down at once.

items.prompt: Play C, E and G together.
Play F, A and C together.

steps.title: Make your own
steps.body: Press any three white keys together and listen. Some groups sound sweet and some clash. Notice which ones you like.

items.prompt: Play G, B and D together.
How many notes are in this chord?
